## Behavior

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and relevant Spec 002 acceptance IDs.
Link the task record or issue. For a docs-only change, state that explicitly.

## Evidence

List checks actually run and their outcomes, with artifact links where available.
Distinguish unrun or blocked checks. For docs-only work, describe document/link
validation; do not imply application tests passed.

## Review focus

State material correctness risks, remaining limitations, and decisions needing
review. If an agent contributed, summarize the scope it handled and any finding
that changed its implementation or instructions.
